「Do whatever you want with me!
　But please, save everyone in this world!」

stage0086_04:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$アマタ$$
「No way!
　I could never abandon $$ミコノ$$!」

stage0086_04:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That day, I watched my mother go!
　And I've regretted it ever since!」

stage0086_04:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So this time, I won't watch you go!
　I won't say goodbye!」

stage0086_04:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Together with the person I love!
　Together with $$ミコノ$$!
　I want to protect this world!」

stage0086_04:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll always be by your side!
　Even if $$ミコノ$$ grows old and wrinkled!
　Even if time stops here and you become myth!」

stage0086_04:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll be right there beside you!」

stage0086_04:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Flying on forever, loving you forever!」

stage0086_04:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I was born to love $$シルフィ$$.
　Across 12,000 years...
　But he loved now... loved $$ミコノ$$ as she is now!」

stage0086_04:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Get lost!
　All of you, get lost to the far side of love!!」

stage0086_04:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Genesis Union! GO!
　$$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$!!」

stage0086_04:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「No, it's not EVOL!
　Its new name is-!」

stage0086_04:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's alright.
　The Wings of the sun have returned to where they belong.」

stage0086_04:r_5777cb06f7e0103f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Looks like that $$ミカゲ$$ bastard vanished too.」

stage0086_04:r_ede6dd5bb2efe029.text:
$$クレア$$
「It seems Altair's approach has stopped too.」

stage0086_04:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$キャシー$$
「The dimensional boundary around Altair is warping.」

stage0086_04:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So it's returning to its original dimension...」

stage0086_04:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$ランカ$$
「$$アルト$$, big brother... everyone...」

stage0086_04:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Well done.
　And thank you.」

stage0086_04:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Wait!
　Detecting a powerful gravity wave near Earth!」

stage0086_04:r_2cd57aac659672dc.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Do you really have time to celebrate your victory?」

stage0086_04:r_984737d2920b03f7.text:
$$タケル$$
「An abnormal gravity wave, of all things!」

stage0086_04:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Just as you imagine.
　My father has come to Earth.」

stage0086_04:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$隼人$$
「This is bad!
　If the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ swallows Earth into a black hole now,
　Altair won't escape either!」

stage0086_04:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Both Earth and Altair will be destroyed!?」

stage0086_04:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Consider this my declaration of war.
　If you wish to save Earth, come, $c.」

stage0086_04:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Before my father gets here, I'll go all out
　and take you all on myself.」

stage0086_04:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$... I have nothing more to say to you.」

stage0086_04:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Both Altair and Vega,
　swallowed into a black hole...!?」

stage0086_04:r_1ce9868e47e05f97.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Like hell I'll let that happen!」

stage0086_04:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... accept the punishment of the gods.」

stage0086_04:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text:
$$カトル$$
「It's no good!
　We can't dodge that attack!」

stage0086_04:r_cb789b091a7a05ca.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Is taking the hit our only option!?」

stage0086_04:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「If only we could cut off the source of his power...!」

stage0086_04:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's pointless, wingless one.
　As long as love cannot be erased, neither can hatred.」

stage0086_04:r_1efac5b6d8fb1238.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Do you understand, $$カグラ$$!
　Our father and mother are dead!」

stage0086_04:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$イズモ$$, Altair's Supreme Commander!」

stage0086_04:r_99128140e453d460.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$イズモ$$, that old geezer... is my father...」

stage0086_04:r_bdf41f6a0fb7b286.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Father entrusted us with the future of both worlds!
　And yet you...!」

stage0086_04:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What's that got to do with anything!」

stage0086_04:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$$カグラ$$
「As long as I have my worst damn woman, I need nothing else!
　Anyone who gets in the way, I'll kill them, whoever they are!」

stage0086_04:r_4f838d45a89974f0.text:
$$カグラ$$
「The weakling's gotten all high and mighty with his anger!
　But you can't beat me!」

stage0086_04:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Shut up, $$カグラ$$!
　I'll stop you, I swear it!」

stage0086_04:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And I'll take back $$ミコノ$$,
　and protect both worlds!!」

stage0086_04:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$$アンディ$$
「We're the best combo there is!」

stage0086_04:r_53dd6bae12e095c3.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Nothing scares me!
　Not with $$アンディ$$ by my side!」

stage0086_04:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Maybe I've got a talent for beast taming...」

stage0086_04:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「All that gloominess from before feels like a lie now!」

stage0086_04:r_83e0e74db0ae4d4f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah...
　This really does suit me better!」

stage0086_04:r_d85829b2f9bff450.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The wingless... much less a child,
　could never understand my love or hatred.」

stage0086_04:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't care, don't scare,
　cock-a-doodle-doo, so there!」

stage0086_04:r_78ebe98c49194738.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No way I'm losing
　to some guy trying to wreck the world out of spite!」

stage0086_04:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here I come, jilted Wing!
　Don't go taking it out on someone else just 'cause I beat you!」

stage0086_04:r_58b16d8cc9b8a2a5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The sun belongs to my beloved Apollonius alone...!
　It doesn't suit your puppet!」

stage0086_04:r_5cf3d385c6d4b8d0.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is our hope!
　And hope lights the future of the world!」

stage0086_04:r_808269c7e458f2a5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is our sun!
　No matter what you say, I'll fight alongside $$鉄人$$!!」

stage0086_04:r_f6f98a8ef73d1d43.text:
$$タケル$$
「A feeling that would destroy the world can't be love!」

stage0086_04:r_3d395121b4205722.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one, denying my love...!?」

stage0086_04:r_9496bdb991cf236a.text:
$$タケル$$
「Someone like you, who steals another's happiness,
　has no right to speak the word 'love'!」

stage0086_04:r_980e935235423ee4.text:
$$タケル$$
「If you love someone,
　you love the whole world they live in!」

stage0086_04:r_dc9b1e7f62a8afc8.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A twin split between light and darkness, acting like you understand!
　You should fall into darkness too!」

stage0086_04:r_d243a6836b127987.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「One who transcends causality.
　I am not one to be pitied by the likes of you!」

stage0086_04:r_cbab585f941e5667.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll put you to sleep.
　if love is what torments you.」

stage0086_04:r_0e1caed2ba333f4e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Are you... the same as me...」

stage0086_04:r_a9e024bdcd6975b2.text:
$$桂$$
「Looks like you're the one who gathered up all the ugly parts of $$頭翅$$!」

stage0086_04:r_e9bd6b1804d36e0a.text:
$$桂$$
「I get what it's like to love someone!
　But just because you got dumped,
　holding a grudge and taking it out on everyone is just too lame!」

stage0086_04:r_7aac40a4f34dcec3.text:
$$桂$$
「Keep talking and you'll only look worse!
　Just quietly exit this world, jilted Wing!」

stage0086_04:r_371b88cba6c82378.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This man's sorrow... it's deep and dark!」

stage0086_04:r_4cb558f092561fde.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A mere wingless one, touching my heart!?」

stage0086_04:r_119dbefe27cdac46.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You, who feel love and hatred,
　are no different from us at all!」

stage0086_04:r_e174d36b825c4290.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　The wingless, the same as the Wings!?」

stage0086_04:r_56176fc60ad96ecd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why we'll stop you!
　Before your hatred leads the world to ruin!!」

stage0086_04:r_160384a0c68215c6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「What a pitiful man you are.」

stage0086_04:r_ee134f0fa96047a6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you keep on living like this,
　you'll one day taste our loneliness, same as the Wings.」

stage0086_04:r_c1cddb7853813703.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Isn't it supposed to be 12,000 years...?!」

stage0086_04:r_3569c3ca91ae0f9d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's the cursed memory carved into the Wings...!
　Know this, wingless one: destroying you now,
　before you get there, is my mercy!」

stage0086_04:r_497aca854c5f874d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I can't follow this man's self-serving logic...!」

stage0086_04:r_1797d61f82be363c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Your love and hatred are none of my concern.」

stage0086_04:r_f2e19618032127d3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No wonder a wingless one can't grasp my feelings.」

stage0086_04:r_9d5428667d48c806.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「All I need
　is the fact that you're an enemy of the world.」

stage0086_04:r_21454fd877c0ae7b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This man's heart... burns hotter than anything...!」

stage0086_04:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Whatever you are,
　if you're an enemy, I'll eliminate you swiftly.」

stage0086_04:r_f612b6b60810e300.text:
$$シン$$
「Even the humans you're trying to destroy
　each have someone they love!
　And yet...!」

stage0086_04:r_09068a6fd74f79b7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How dreadful.
　I don't even want to think a wingless one
　could feel something like we do.」

stage0086_04:r_4ff0d278b79d1168.text:
$$シン$$
「If you're going to drag the world
　into your hatred like that...!」

stage0086_04:r_b101d62bbac1b33b.text:
$$シン$$
「I'll show you!
　That humans too will stake their lives
　fighting for what matters to them!」

stage0086_04:r_72be9250b889c959.text:
$$キラ$$
「You fight with a feeling called hatred
　and a power called Aquarion...」

stage0086_04:r_402b4aaf0ee30986.text:
$$キラ$$
「But where you're aiming it is wrong...!」

stage0086_04:r_2cfc9851abe4070e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one, lecturing me on reason...!」

stage0086_04:r_0831afdf480052ed.text:
$$キラ$$
「If you won't understand what we're telling you,
　then I'll fight you...!」

stage0086_04:r_1c9bf7ffbf9314a5.text:
$$キラ$$
「With the feelings and the strength inside me!」

stage0086_04:r_adc5793509f8d46c.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you've touched my sorrow.
　Then you must have trembled at its depth and darkness, no?」

stage0086_04:r_f581e32ff0b84e01.text:
$$刹那$$
「But that's no reason to destroy the world!」

stage0086_04:r_c5ffa17ba0fae8d3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It seems you've come a little further
　than the other wingless ones.」

stage0086_04:r_b251d2d3a7cdba85.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And that power will make you lonely.
　When it does, will you still be able to deny me?」

stage0086_04:r_abc1d4645695a0e0.text:
$$刹那$$
「...I don't know what lies ahead.
　But I can't let you go,
　not while you're trying to destroy the world!」

stage0086_04:r_ae527ac0a641a269.text:
$$刹那$$
「To protect this world's future, I'll fight you!!」

stage0086_04:r_b76534e2de5b6334.text:
$$バナージ$$
「One who nips the future... nips possibility itself...!
　You're an enemy of the world!」

stage0086_04:r_ee41ea400d1ee0bf.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one has no future either way.
　You'd be happier destroyed by me here.」

stage0086_04:r_eb56670c83981cc6.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm not putting up with logic like that!」

stage0086_04:r_90b6cb0493a2982b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You may indeed be a dangerous existence...
　Perhaps I can't just leave you be.」

stage0086_04:r_a5181af1cc2bdd02.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't let you have your way!
　Not with me, not with this world!!」

stage0086_04:r_357749a704e3cf55.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who carry the blood of beasts.
　Have you ever thought about why
　you exist in this world?」

stage0086_04:r_9da55d8320b82bc6.text:
$$葵$$
「I've got no interest in your philosophical games.」

stage0086_04:r_8d5dbaa0f1e069de.text:
$$葵$$
「Or your annoying sob story about love, either!」

stage0086_04:r_7accc1b1cfd86010.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Seems you want to die, wingless one.」

stage0086_04:r_301d85713d2cddd7.text:
$$葵$$
「Team D's not weak enough
　to lose to a guy wrecking the world over getting dumped!」

stage0086_04:r_59a1074cc884fdbd.text:
$$葵$$
「If you love destruction that much,
　go blow yourself up somewhere out of sight!」

stage0086_04:r_b66bbe1f07a7674e.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Hear my song, and that gloomy mood blows right away!」

stage0086_04:r_fa7a261c85f92c5a.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I go, Wings!
　Liiisten to my soooong!!」

stage0086_04:r_16141de28d738543.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Ah... the power of life...
　My hatred is being healed...）

stage0086_04:r_39d8b5a2657c65a4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（But I mustn't forgive...!
　Apollonius... the world Apollonius loved...!）

stage0086_04:r_1a123affe838b8b1.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A sinful man, toying with the love of two maidens...」

stage0086_04:r_f9ff2a77c392a048.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A sinner like you has no right to judge me.」

stage0086_04:r_54e755252ec3acc4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So you were aware of it after all...
　Then come, fall into the darkness with me...」

stage0086_04:r_84e951432a30244f.text:
$$アルト$$
「I've no interest in hearing the words
　of someone who gives in to heartbreak and hates others!」

stage0086_04:r_97923e3dd5dae64b.text:
$$アルト$$
「What I have to do right now
　is protect $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$, and protect the world!」

stage0086_04:r_c8b34405ed7bfde7.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Putting off the problem like that, are you?」

stage0086_04:r_286cd6be5271ecd2.text:
$$アルト$$
「My mind's made up...!
　And that's none of your business!!」

stage0086_04:r_93b46e3c24ed4825.text:
$$竜馬$$
「God, Wings, whatever you are, I don't care,
　if you're my enemy, I'll smash you!」

stage0086_04:r_d7cd6f0e351ca403.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You eternal warrior chosen by the Getter rays...!
　So you're here too!」

stage0086_04:r_4b3e91da51d87c72.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Seems like you know something
　about the Getter rays too.」

stage0086_04:r_912c58272c320559.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you want to know the answer, wingless one?」

stage0086_04:r_5f455447e0703bcf.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I've got no interest in that.」

stage0086_04:r_378632856490e9d0.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You mean to refuse evolution of your own will!?」

stage0086_04:r_0a93eeae43e226f4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If I wanna move forward, I'll do it on my own feet!」

stage0086_04:r_5d3ee1804aedfa48.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who inherit the power of the god of light!
　As if a wingless one could wield that power!」

stage0086_04:r_7fd3cd80460fefb1.text:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up, you dumped bastard!
　I promised $$ゼウス$$
　I'd carve out the future with our own strength!」

stage0086_04:r_b99c671eb373edd1.text:
$$甲児$$
「The darkness in you, trying to destroy the world,
　I'll break it with the light of Mazinger and me!」

stage0086_04:r_0f9b6f684aa8f438.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You don't know your place...!
　Fall into the darkness of my heart and despair in the black!」

stage0086_04:r_23d7f155539c7c51.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A powerless wingless one, coming at me?」

stage0086_04:r_c8e48adccc9bbba8.text:
$$赤木$$
「Sure, I'm just an ordinary salaryman,
　but I've got something splendid that you don't!」

stage0086_04:r_ed6e99341ad5bf40.text:
$$赤木$$
「Guts and spirit!
　That's why, even if I got dumped like you did,
　I wouldn't take it out on everyone!」

stage0086_04:r_a671f14759794503.text:
$$赤木$$
「Destroying the world out of spite and blame,
　just understand already
　how pathetic that is!!」

stage0086_04:r_7ff5aecfd0f37b20.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Black Megadeus, I remember you too.」

stage0086_04:r_ed9690679f1aa20f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A memory from 12,000 years ago, is it.」

stage0086_04:r_121b55dcb47984aa.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No...
　Further back than that... a memory from 120,000,000 years ago.」

stage0086_04:r_a378a46f62b5980d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「From the looks of it, the memory's still sealed away.」

stage0086_04:r_aeef429ff90ba18f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But you'll come to know it eventually.
　What the system your god left behind means.」

stage0086_04:r_f0ce8e3e0d75533e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm sick of men who spout nonsense...!
　Such fellows had better vanish from my sight!」

stage0086_04:r_87e728176c45393f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who inherit the god's legacy...
　why don't you use that power to guide the wingless?」

stage0086_04:r_5aa4e72c511af6eb.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Eternity is something humanity doesn't need.」

stage0086_04:r_8e2f92d078970a2b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How foolish, to give up the path to godhood yourself...」

stage0086_04:r_e8ecfd162319c1e6.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Not enough to drag the world into misplaced spite.」

stage0086_04:r_0bb68446ec330a05.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「What this world needs isn't a frozen eternity,
　but a future overflowing with possibility!」

stage0086_04:r_8e1ebf6b0c149f4b.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「My comrades and I will drive off the dark that seals it!」

stage0086_04:r_86f0e9b721a4f655.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one who knows nothing of love...」

stage0086_04:r_c42f7ca81fe0cf88.text:
$$宗介$$
「But compared to you, drowning in love
　and spouting worthless nonsense, I live better.」

stage0086_04:r_4c845bb8b05d3b13.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Pitiful...
　Love is supreme... above this entire world.」

stage0086_04:r_836fc0eae35929e9.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then I will defeat you,
　and take my time finding out for myself!」

stage0086_04:r_aed2fc42c9a9ecdd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wing dog, daring to defy me!?」

stage0086_04:r_ebc3eec9f9e218b1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm no wing dog Polon, and no Apollo!
　I'm $$アマタ・ソラ$$!」

stage0086_04:r_271fbb35b579a866.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm not bound by the past like you!
　I fight for the present, and for the future!」

stage0086_04:r_b40fe3d3e6f2b1d9.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You have no future!
　I will destroy everything Apollonius loved!」

stage0086_04:r_778c6eb2f5afc622.text:
$$アマタ$$
「As if I'd bow to your hatred!
　We have a love that won't lose to it!」

stage0086_04:r_3fb74a41e682c7de.text:
$$アマタ$$
「My friends, my comrades, my family, the world...
　and $$ミコノ$$, I love them all!
　As long as I have this love, I won't lose to you!!」

stage0086_04:r_47c1edbfd5664fd7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$!
　I'm taking $$ミコノ$$ and this world's future
　back from you!!」

stage0086_04:r_d1b8cb87f8ea00d6.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I will never forgive you for using us!」

stage0086_04:r_bba76accfb31e66d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I merely lent a hand to the desires already inside you.
　Please stop pushing the blame onto me.」

stage0086_04:r_199a6e6247ffb58b.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'll admit that!
　But we've changed!」

stage0086_04:r_6095c82e60cdd7af.text:
$$カグラ$$
「We don't go around
　whining forever about the past like you do!」

stage0086_04:r_ad702e22165a11de.text:
$$カグラ$$
「For the world we're going to live in... for the future,
　you're disappearing, $$ミカゲ$$!!」

stage0086_04:r_df79b5dc7ceda4c0.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll fight!
　To protect the world's future!」

stage0086_04:r_48a06834bb510d7d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「How admirable...
　even though the world you came from
　was destroyed by an embodiment of endless destruction.」

stage0086_04:r_f19a063712278769.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I don't believe that!
　The fight Big Sis and everyone and I fought
　protected the future!」

stage0086_04:r_48fd2b5d0978ba1c.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's the same in this world!
　To fight against something like you,
　$$ガンバスター$$ and I are here!」

stage0086_04:r_90591ae4aa6d92d6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The wind's path leads to Tengen...
　And what waits beyond it is despair...」

stage0086_04:r_3c39aed29379134c.text:
$$シモン$$
「That despair, my drill will bore right through it!」

stage0086_04:r_bff5468c57365d6b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A wingless one who doesn't know his place...
　Do you even know what awaits beyond that despair?」

stage0086_04:r_9520c4f160aa3ebd.text:
$$シモン$$
「Whatever waits, if it's my enemy, I'll bore through!」

stage0086_04:r_9dc3c6963e7dac77.text:
$$シモン$$
「My drill is the power to move forward into the future!
　Someone like you, drowning in despair,
　can't stop me!」

stage0086_04:r_173107393504e4d1.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The door to a new world... a vessel for a god's descent...
　But you don't know the meaning of your own existence.」

stage0086_04:r_48e8a7d08b0e09ba.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... sorry to him, but,
　since you came at me, I'll punish you too.」

stage0086_04:r_7d5585f6d8b1df8d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I hate people like that,
　who talk like only they understand and move others around!」

stage0086_04:r_5933be40e8f9d954.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I won't let someone like that
　do whatever they want with the world everyone lives in!」

stage0086_04:r_bd5c0088c2d22ef6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I see...
　It's no wonder you'd think that.」

stage0086_04:r_77fc21c69be0890c.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But you're making a huge mistake.」

stage0086_04:r_7b9baf664ed0cd70.text:
$n
「The way you talk about him like he's not even human...!
　I don't like it!」

stage0086_04:r_d8483ee925825d04.text:
$n
「I know it well.
　I'm the one who hunts angels...!」

stage0086_04:r_dae622560a4cfc83.text:
$n
「You, destroying the world, are my prey!!」

stage0086_04:r_d0acd2176373fca3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「S-stop it!
　Don't look at me with those moist round eyes!」

stage0086_04:r_55d74e6e4298cda9.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ah...!
　The anger inside me, the hatred...!
　24,000 years of darkness, melting away...!」

stage0086_04:r_2e7c2f5aef3a7531.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then, beloved beast!
　Let me pour my love into you!」
